_about: Sound-effect shot list for option 1, one entry per on-screen action (times are global seconds in the ad). tools/generate_sfx.mjs sends each prompt to ElevenLabs Sound Effects and saves the takes in audio-src/sfx/elevenlabs/.

sounds.name: room-tone
sounds.text: Very quiet cozy kitchen room tone in the morning, soft air, distant birds outside a window, no voices, no music

sounds.name: leaf-drop
sounds.text: A single small dry leaf lands softly on still water, tiny gentle plip and a faint ripple, close-up, quiet room

sounds.name: boil-rise
sounds.text: Water inside an electric kettle heating up to a rolling boil, rumbling and bubbling that builds in intensity, close microphone

sounds.name: marker-x
sounds.text: Thick marker pen drawing two quick strokes of an X on paper

sounds.name: switch-off
sounds.text: Electric kettle power switch clicked off, one crisp plastic click, then sudden silence

sounds.name: freeze-air
sounds.text: Subtle airy suspended tension, time standing still, very soft, a gentle reversed swell rising at the very end

sounds.name: counter-detents
sounds.text: Rotary dial turned slowly, soft precise mechanical detent clicks, about twenty clicks, quiet and close

sounds.name: leaves-burst
sounds.text: A handful of fresh green leaves tossed into the air, soft rustling flutter

sounds.name: underline
sounds.text: Felt-tip marker drawing one quick underline stroke on paper

sounds.name: ring-whoosh
sounds.text: Soft short airy whoosh passing by, subtle and clean

sounds.name: pencil-sketch
sounds.text: Pencil quickly sketching confident lines on paper

sounds.name: reveal-sweep
sounds.text: Soft elegant reveal sweep, gentle airy rising tone, subtle premium product reveal

sounds.name: led-beep
sounds.text: Modern electric kettle digital display turning on, one short soft high electronic beep

sounds.name: callout-tick
sounds.text: Very soft subtle minimal interface tick, clean and quiet

sounds.name: gourd-set
sounds.text: Wooden mate gourd with a metal straw set down gently on a wooden table, hollow wooden knock and a small metal clink

sounds.name: kettle-lift
sounds.text: Lifting a cordless electric kettle off its base, soft plastic unclick

sounds.name: pour
sounds.text: Hot water pouring from a thin gooseneck kettle spout into a small wooden mate gourd full of yerba mate leaves, steady thin stream, gentle gurgle, ending with a few drips

sounds.name: kettle-return
sounds.text: Placing an electric kettle back onto its base, soft solid plastic clunk

sounds.name: sun-rise
sounds.text: Warm gentle rising shimmer like a sunrise, soft and airy

sounds.name: marker-circle
sounds.text: Marker pen drawing one quick circle on paper

sounds.name: power-flow
sounds.text: Soft electrical energy flowing through a wire, gentle crackle and low hum, subtle

sounds.name: button-press
sounds.text: Pressing a soft-touch power button on an electric kettle base, small click followed by a short electronic beep

sounds.name: dial-turn
sounds.text: Turning a rotary temperature dial on a kitchen appliance, smooth ratcheting clicks

sounds.name: ready-beep
sounds.text: Electric kettle double beep, target temperature reached, two short soft pleasant beeps

sounds.name: steam
sounds.text: Soft steam rising from a hot drink, gentle quiet hiss

sounds.name: leaf-flight
sounds.text: A single leaf flying through the air with a soft swoosh

sounds.name: logo-settle
sounds.text: Soft elegant logo appearance, gentle wooden knock with a light shimmer

sounds.name: call-to-action
sounds.text: Soft warm premium confirmation sound, subtle and friendly
